messages:
Ashok: Opening follow-up from last week's multi-vendor outage. Sharing action items from the postmortem — want to confirm owners + timelines. Focus areas: cloud auth token expiry, model-registry GC/latency, and fallback routing to alternate providers.
Maria: Thanks — I can own the auth rotation work (A1). ETA end of next week. Will add test plan and runbook steps.
Devin: I'll take model-registry GC tuning (A2). Need access to retention configs & S3 access logs. @Maria can you drop link?
Maria: s3://redwood-postmortem/1765-model-registry-logs ✅ I also added a short ops-summary in the doc.
Ryan: Ops will validate fallback routing + failover sequencing (A3). Can we define clear SLA gates that trigger auto-failover? My proposal: p90 > 500ms OR error rate > 1% sustained for 5m.
Lucy: +1. I'll prototype a circuit-breaker + backoff config and open a PR against infra.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1765-followup — owners: Ashok, Maria, Devin, Ryan. Next check-in scheduled Tue 09:30 PT.
Ashok: Two asks: 1) Weekly recurrence watch for 90 days to catch patterns. 2) A vendor->fallback mapping table (regions, model providers, auth fallback). Who takes mapping?
Sam: I'll own vendor mapping (A4). Will include cloud region fallback, model-provider alternatives, and auth provider rotation plan. ETA 2 weeks.
Maria: For A1 adding a KMS key rotation dry-run and a pre-rollover smoke test. Will post test checklist here by EOD tomorrow.
Devin: For A2 current snapshot frequency is hourly. Suggest: hourly for hot shards, daily for warm, weekly for cold. Will propose exact retention/compaction settings in the doc.
Ashok: Scheduling owners & quick ETAs: A1 auth+KMS (Maria, eta 2026-03-30), A2 registry GC (Devin, eta 2026-03-31), A3 fallback routing (Ryan + Lucy, eta 2026-04-05), A4 vendor mapping (Sam, eta 2026-04-06). Weekly check-ins until all items closed.
Ryan: I'll add a canary smoke test validating failover path and alerting if it deviates. Reference: https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/failover-smoke
Maria: Quick question — Ashok, priority order for failover sequencing? Dedicated customers vs Hosted?
Ashok: Priority: Dedicated first (SLA), then Hosted. Documented.
Sam: Adding vendor mapping doc to the postmortem folder and flagging legal for contract renewal/SLAs.
Ashok: If no objections I'll create Jira epics for each action and close this thread. Please reply if any timeline conflicts.
Lucy: No objections from infra team. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: INC-1765-followup-checkin Tue 09:30 PT.
